name: agent-os
description: An agent operating system for legacy / high-ambiguity codebases. Scaffolds frontmatter-scannable task & error docs, source-of-truth docs, a generated index with coldness-based compaction (/agent-os:archive), a SessionStart nudge when memory grows large, an opt-in forced-sync git hook, and three self-maintaining router skills (task-scan, error-check, error-log). Run /agent-os:init to install it into any project.
